name: Zettai Fukujuu Meirei
source:
Welcome, one and all, to our little Agency. I'm sure that at one time or another, you've felt frustrated by the actions of a certain troublesome individual, who always seems to make your life more difficult. You know the feeling -- through no fault of your own, your every step is hindered by the actions of someone who's been born onto this Earth just to trip you up?

That's where our Agency comes in. With just one word from you, our special volunteer staff will happily lay a complex trap for the individual who causes you so much frustration, and exact sweet revenge on the troublemaker for you, turning their life into exactly the kind of living hell you want. We'll make them surrender totally to our will, force them into absolute obedience while we punish them for the crime of tormenting you. Of course, we use the word "volunteer" loosely. Payment is always required for our services, but don't worry -- we'll never ask you for money.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20080322232856/http://www.peachprincess.com/Merchant2/merchant.mv?Screen=PROD&Product_Code=LANG002&Category_Code=]Peach Princess[/url]]
translation:
欢迎各位来到我们这家小小的事务所。我相信，大家或多或少都曾因某个麻烦人物的所作所为而感到恼火：那个人总是让你的生活更加难过。你应该懂这种感受——明明不是自己的错，却处处被某个仿佛生来就是为了给你使绊子的人阻碍前进的脚步。

这正是本事务所能够派上用场的地方。只要你开口，我们的特殊志愿员工就会乐意为那个让你烦恼不已的人布下复杂的陷阱，并替你向这名麻烦制造者讨回甜美的报复，把对方的生活变成你想要的那种人间地狱。我们会让他们彻底向我们的意志屈服，强迫他们绝对服从，同时惩罚他们折磨你的罪行。当然，“志愿”这个词只是宽泛地说说。我们的服务一律收费，不过你放心——我们绝不会向你索要金钱。

[译自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20080322232856/http://www.peachprincess.com/Merchant2/merchant.mv?Screen=PROD&Product_Code=LANG002&Category_Code=]Peach Princess[/url]]
